description:
We are ATHERIS, a team of curious young innovators passionate about space, science, technology and solving real-world challenges. We aim to turn creative ideas into meaningful solutions through research, collaboration and innovation.

We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in programming, AI, astronomy, data science, GIS, UI/UX design, research and communication. Beginners with curiosity and a willingness to learn are welcome too!

Let's explore, innovate and make an impact together!
